snippet.title: TORMENTOR - Darknet Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet your host - Hades, and join the Cerberus organization! 
👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493440/TORMENTOR/

----------------------------------

TORMENTOR is an upcoming horror game where you take on the role of a ruthless tormentor managing an abandoned prison filled with victims sentenced to death.

As your mental state deteriorates, your memories erode, and your blackouts become more dangerous, you must work with an underground criminal network via the Dark Web to secure doses of an experimental drug—your only chance at maintaining clarity.

🔗 Join the community: https://discord.gg/wAdPYtUf3k

📲 Follow for updates: https://linke.to/TORMENTOR #horrorgame  #videogame #gaming #indiegame #horror
